Question Choices: A robot completes 2/3 of a task in 5/12 of an hour. Compute its task rate in tasks per hour. Enter only the number with no units.
Hints: Divide the amount by the time or other input; multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor.
Solution: (2/3) ÷ (5/12) = (2/3)*(12/5)=24/15=1.6. The quotient is the amount per one unit of the denominator quantity. Check: rate × the original time/input recovers the original amount. Exact calculation: (2 ÷ 3) ÷ (5 ÷ 12) = 1.6.
